cand.title: Semana Internacional de la Construcción – SICON
cand.excerpt: Strong event evidence and clear Guadalajara demand mechanism; accessibility is discounted where the venue or incumbent hotel is confirmed.

quote.assumption: exa agent fixed effort=high (contact enrichment not included)

findings.namedBuyers: Verified organizer-side relationship candidates are Elena Hurtado, director general of Expo Guadalajara, and Ana Sánchez Terán, director of International Expansion at IFEMA MADRID, both linked directly to SICON. Juan Manuel Chávez is identified as CMIC coordinator for SICON. They are potential routing/sponsorship relationships, not verified hotel-contract signatories. The 2026 release reports 38 hosted buyers from 19 brands; these are construction-product buyers, not evidence of accommodation purchasing authority.
findings.futureEdition: Confirmed second edition: 20–22 April 2027, 10:00–18:00, Expo Guadalajara. The venue calendar explicitly supplies activity dates; the organizer’s 17 April 2026 closing release independently announces those same 2027 dates. This is within the requested horizon, not an expired one-time lead. No 2028 edition dates were verified; an isolated 2028 date in the news index is an article label, not edition evidence.
findings.hotelProductFit: Inference: Sheraton Guadalajara Expo is suitable for exhibitor teams, visiting speakers and out-of-town professional delegates seeking city-hotel accommodation near the exhibition, with possible ancillary meetings/catering rather than relocation of the main show. Marriott places the hotel minutes from Expo Guadalajara and advertises meeting spaces, catering and event-planning assistance. This is an urban business-travel thesis, not a destination-resort programme. The supplied 216-room inventory is hotel capacity, not SICON demand. The organizer lists “Hotel Sheraton Guadalajara,” but that wording alone does not verify an agreement with this exact property.
findings.venueCommitments: The 2027 venue listing names Expo Guadalajara, Salón Jalisco A y B. This is a published venue commitment, not inspection of a signed contract. The event is not committed to a competing hotel as its exhibition venue. Separately, the organizer’s accommodation page advertises a special agreement with Barceló Guadalajara; its edition validity, exclusivity, room allocation and contract terms are not disclosed.
findings.historicalRotation: The inaugural edition ran 14–16 April 2026 at Expo Guadalajara; the second is announced for the same city and venue in April 2027. These establish continuity across two consecutive years, not a demonstrated destination-rotation programme or an indefinite annual schedule. No prior SICON México host destination was established.
findings.accommodationSourcing: Hotel sourcing status: unknown/unconfirmed, neither verified open nor verified closed. A public accommodation pathway exists through the organizer’s lodging page, which advertises a Barceló agreement and hotel contact details. Its FAQ also lists RIU Guadalajara, Hotel Sheraton Guadalajara, Hotel Westin Guadalajara, Real Inn, Barceló and Hampton Inn Expo. These recommendations do not prove room blocks or availability. Approach the SICON team through igomez@expoguadalajara.mx, +52 33 1865 6427, or its official contact form to identify the accommodation decision-maker. The email is published, but its holder’s full name was not verified. No appointed PCO/DMC, accommodation RFP, booking deadline or centralized rooming process was verified.
findings.organizationStructure: SICON is coorganized by Expo Guadalajara and IFEMA MADRID, in collaboration with CMIC/CMIC Jalisco. Treat it as an organizer-led B2B construction trade exhibition with association participation, not a sports/entertainment event or an association-owned congress. Expo Guadalajara is both coorganizer and exhibition venue; CMIC is a collaborating industry body. No independent agency/PCO/DMC appointment or hotel buyer was established.
findings.competitiveLimitations: Barceló Guadalajara has a publicly advertised special accommodation agreement and is described by the organizer as directly opposite Expo Guadalajara. Other recommended hotels compete for delegates. No exclusivity, sold-out inventory, overflow requirement, contracted room-night commitment, rate comparison or guaranteed Sheraton allocation was verified. The Barceló agreement limits assumptions of an uncontested opportunity but does not establish that all hotel sourcing is closed.
findings.recommendedSalesAction: Contact the published SICON local channel now, referencing 20–22 April 2027. Ask who manages delegate accommodation and hosted-buyer travel; whether “Hotel Sheraton Guadalajara” denotes this property and an existing agreement; whether the Barceló agreement applies to 2027 and is exclusive; and whether additional hotels or exhibitor-direct rates are accepted. Offer a conditional guestrooms-plus-small-meeting proposal only after requirements and availability are established. Request referral through Elena Hurtado or Ana Sánchez Terán if the operational buyer is not identified. Do not present an unsolicited offer as a response to a published RFP.
findings.currentEditionAccessibility: For the next edition, April 2027, the exhibition venue is already selected and a competing hotel agreement is publicly promoted. Hotel participation remains unconfirmed. Sheraton’s presence in the general lodging FAQ offers a relationship-checking route, not evidence of an open block or current commercial agreement. The April 2026 edition is historical and cannot be sold as upcoming.
findings.futureCompetitiveCapturePotential: Inference: pursue preferred-hotel inclusion or renewal for 2027 if the organizer confirms access; otherwise cultivate an accommodation relationship for a later edition. Two consecutive editions support relationship development, but no 2028 dates, procurement cycle or hotel-partner renewal window are verified. Do not label later-cycle capture as a confirmed 2028 opportunity.
